title: VHS Tape Label
description: A dimensional VHS cassette drops in with spinning reels, a handwritten-era paper label, tape markings, and deterministic analog wear.

title: Tracking Wobble Title
description: Oversized title type splits into chromatic channels while deterministic tracking slips, scanlines, timecode, and tape noise pass over frame.

title: Chrome Sunset
description: Chrome-gradient display lettering rises over a striped neon sun and advancing perspective grid for a polished 1980s title card.

title: Arcade High Score
description: A pixel-styled title types into an arcade playfield with blinking stars, a live score bar, stage counter, and press-start prompt.

title: Polaroid Memory
description: An instant-photo card falls onto a textured surface, develops from white, and reveals a warm faux landscape with period timestamp.

title: CRT Channel Flip
description: A woodgrain CRT set cycles channels as its physical dial turns, screen content rolls, collapses, and returns beneath curved-glass scanlines.

title: Retro Computer Boot
description: A green-phosphor computer performs memory checks, mounts a tape, types a title command, and settles on a blinking DOS-style prompt.

title: Synthwave Horizon Drive
description: A neon highway races toward a striped sunset through a procedural skyline, moving grid, glowing lane markers, and bold outrun title type.

title: Broadcast Test Card
description: A period broadcast test card combines SMPTE-inspired bars, calibration geometry, a rotating clock hand, recording stamp, and analog interference.

title: Film Leader Countdown
description: A vintage academy-style leader counts down inside concentric calibration rings with rotating sweep, gate jitter, scratches, and end flash.
